mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_participant ( settlement_id, user_id, participant_role, participant_status, joined_at ) VALUES ( #{settlementId}, #{userId}, #{participantRole}, #{participantStatus}, #{joinedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT participant_id, user_id, settlement_id, participant_role, participant_status, joined_at FROM settlement_participant WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND participant_status = 'ACTIVE'
